facts.fact: The OBS-CC observatory states that law no. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 institutes the Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP).
The OBS-CC observatory states that the APDP is not yet installed and that the implementing decree under article 53 has not been taken.

Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 creates the Autorité de protection des données à caractère personnel, a CLG Global analysis says, but its formal establishment depends on a presidential decree and it is not yet operational.

facts.fact: ACTPOL says the Authority is named in the 2024 law but its creation is left to a presidential decree, and it found none as of July 2026.

OBS-CC says Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 creates the Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP) in article 53, but the presidential decree organising it and appointing members had not been published when it checked the presidency's list on 14 September 2026.
